messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: `billing-metering-pulse` in eu-prod — token-reporting delay + spike in overage flags. P1. Link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/6182467890
alice.sre: seeing a ~5m window where emitter writebacks retried and then the metering pipeline applied duplicates. kafka consumer lag jumped. starting triage.
ben.billing: confirmed customer-facing overage flags for ~12 accounts (small & mid-market). counts doubled for some windows. grabbing sample ids.
maria.support: CS is getting inbound — customers reporting "sudden overage" emails. Can we confirm scope quickly? want a safe comms note. :worried:
ben.billing: sample customer hashes (anonymized): cst-9a3, cst-78b, cst-e12. They align with requests using the embed endpoint ~13:01-13:06 UTC.
alice.sre: running quick kafka check:
```
# kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group metering-ingest
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
metering-raw    4          982341          993578          11237
```
alice.sre: lag spike coincides with emitter autoscale event and a flood of retries. Possible duplicate emitter writes + late-window aggregation.
tom.ingest: deployed a config patch at 13:04 to backoff emitter retries (diff):
```
- retry.count: 5
+ retry.count: 1
+ dedup-window-ms: 300000
```
tom.ingest: note — the dedup logic was introduced but not enabled for the embed path; enabling now. rolling patch to 2 pods.
lisa.platform: rolling a read-only reconciliation job to generate a remediation ledger snapshot. will run in 30m and then reapply corrections.
ben.billing: root cause hypothesis: emitter retry race + missing dedup on embed writes => duplicate tokens emitted -> aggregation counted them as separate tokens -> overage flags.
maria.support: recommended comms: short acknow, we're investigating and will reverse incorrect charges. draft: "We're investigating inflated usage alerts from 13:00-13:10 UTC for some customers. We're rolling fixes and will issue credits as needed."
alice.sre: mitigation plan (short): 1) suppress automated overage emails (done at 13:10) 2) enforce dedup window on emitter (in progress) 3) run reconciliation job and backfill corrected counts 4) manual credits for impacted accounts 5) postmortem + fuzz tests.
ben.billing: starting manual credit workflow now, getting approval from finance. will attach ticket IDs when done.
alice.sre: temporary routing: route embed writes to dedicated ingest pool to avoid concurrent emitter autoscale thrash (small traffic shift). Applying now.
maria.support: thanks — CS will hold outbound comms until we have time estimate. asking for ETA on reconciliation.
lisa.platform: snapshot job scheduled at 13:20 UTC, reconciliation expected to finish by ~14:10 UTC (est). will update if slips.
tom.ingest: patch rolled to 2/2 pods, dedup enabled for embed, observed no new duplicate writebacks since 13:07 UTC.
ben.billing: confirmed suppression of new overage flags. existing flags are being rescored by reconciliation job.
alice.sre: monitoring: token ingestion rate back to expected baseline, kafka lag trending down.
incident-bot: Update: Pager acknowledged by oncall alice.sre and ben.billing. Severity remains P1 until reconciliation completes.
maria.support: CS note ready to send after recon complete. Will mention: credits & apology.
ben.billing: finance approved credits for impacted accounts. created ticket FIN-7421 and will attach ledger IDs.
alice.sre: action items assigned: tom.ingest (enable dedup config + post-deploy smoke), lisa.platform (reconciliation + snapshot), ben.billing (credits + customer list), maria.support (comm template + CS queue).
alice.sre: rapid postmortem will be scheduled tomorrow. tagging for follow-up: add load test against emitter retry scenarios.
maria.support: +1 on comm template. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
